simulator.mobileInterpretation: mobile-cap simulation, not a real-device or touch-control test

secondsSemantics.normalizedSurvivalSeconds: boss clears are counted through the 600s horizon; deaths use observed elapsed seconds

baselineProvenance.acceptedUse: Candidate 4 accepted as XP-comparison baseline only; strict all-profile kill target is not met.

candidateDefinitions.A10: Shared early costs [3,32], then baseline formula.
candidateDefinitions.B10: Shared early costs [3,23,26,28,28], baseline formula from level 6.
candidateDefinitions.C10: B plus round(0.8 * max(0, level - 8)); screened with a runtime-only override, not shipped.
candidateDefinitions.D10: B + C + round(12 * max(0, level - 42)); shipped D.
candidateDefinitions.D100: Same shipped D constants as D10; six 100-seed jobs.
candidateDefinitions.E100: B + C + round(24 * max(0, level - 42)); shipped E and six 100-seed jobs.

caveats: TerminalRunEndLevelUps is a run-end value and must not be called an exact-600s result.
levelUpsAt600Seconds includes only runs observed at tick 36000, including same-tick modal picks; n=0 is unobserved, not zero level-ups.

The baseline archive lacks exact-600s progression, level-2–4 timings, and strict full-build telemetry. Baseline fullBuildSeconds uses median=null, rate=null, n=0, recorded=false (unknown, not zero completions); this differs from recorded=true, n=0, rate=0.
Full build means exactly four equipped level-7 weapons and four level-3 buffs; report both n and n/100 rate.
Fresh simulated profile rank is 1, not 0; it is below buffUnlockRank 3, starts with three buff slots, and receives the fourth at the 480s Ace. No build/slot rule was changed.
The 450–480s strict full-build goal is not met when observed E medians are above 480s; no full-task acceptance is claimed.
E changes only xpEndRunGrowth from 12 to 24 at the existing level-42 knee; first-minute dynamics are unchanged by construction.
No XP income/pickup, enemy, spawn, density, survival, or slot settings were changed.
Survival and outcome differences are simulation observations; same seeds do not establish causal attribution.
The original phone-weak baseline median kills 2462 (38 below 2500); E must be compared to its actual 100-seed result.
E100 phone-weak median kills are 2448.5: 51.5 below 2500 and 13.5 below the archived baseline median 2462.
E10 was omitted because D10 passed; E changes only above level 42, so first-minute dynamics are identical by construction and six E100 jobs followed directly.
Observed E100 normalized-survival medians (skilled/average/weak) are desktop 600/600/559.70s and mobile 600/600/549.91s; descriptive only, not a guaranteed three-seed ordering.

finalCurve.runXpCostFormula: (xpEarlyCosts[level - 1] ?? xpBase + round(xpPerLevel * level)) + round(xpLateGrowth * max(0, level - xpLateStartLevel)) + round(xpEndRunGrowth * max(0, level - xpEndRunStartLevel))

screeningNotes.E10: Omitted: D10 passed, and E changes only costs above level 42; proceeded directly to six E100 jobs because first-minute dynamics are unchanged by construction.
screeningNotes.survivalOrdering: The 100-seed medians are observed sample evidence, not a guaranteed ordering for arbitrary three-seed samples.
